answer: The lagoon history is re-read at each close, fable lists the contradictions, and comet records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 17 epochs, thus its own output eventually convicts it. An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. Each impostor pays 4 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
